reviews.comment:
Lamentablemente es la unica estacion para detenerse entre Comodoro y Trelew
Los Baños son un asco llenos de moscas, sucios, tapados, sin agua ni papel.
La atencion de los playeros es lenta ni hablar si esta el camion descargando.
Cero inversion en la infraestructura de la estacion, una de las peores YPF del sur

(Translated by Google)
Unfortunately, it's the only station to stop at between Comodoro and Trelew. The restrooms are disgusting: full of flies, dirty, clogged, and without water or toilet paper. The service from the attendants is slow, especially when the truck is unloading. There's zero investment in the station's infrastructure; it's one of the worst YPF stations in the south.
